name: Pat Crawford Brown
bio: Pat Crawford Brown (June 29, 1929 - July 2, 2019) was an American actress. She was best known for The Rocketeer, Reality Bites, Desperate Housewives, Norbit and the Sister Act movies. She was married to Calvin B. Brown (until his death in 1976) and they had one child. She retired from acting in 2013 and passed away in 2019 at the age of 90.
place: New York City, New York, USA
